description: Stage 4c-2 dedicated cases: empty statements (`;`) and labeled statements claimed by the generic statement shell, plus the constructs that stay on the legacy path (declaration family / import-export / nested block / function-method body). Each case asserts: (1) shell-path XML == legacy-path XML byte for byte (the harness parses the same source again with StatementRouteUtil.EnableShellExpressions=false); (2) AST node-for-node == ts.createSourceFile; (3) two parses of the same source give identical XML; (4) no StatementShape shell leaks into the shape tree. Takeover counters (ControlFlowShellCount / LabelShellCount / BlockBodyStatementCount) and the no-file-fallback expectation are asserted by tests/statement-possible/control-flow-takeover.mjs; readings are recorded in HANDOFF-s4c2.md.

stage4c2.stage: Stage 4c-2 (empty statements + labeled statements shelled; coverage boundaries re-measured)
stage4c2.description: Empty statement (`;`, `;;`, after a block-bodied statement, inside a block body, after an if/while pair) and labeled statements (`en: a;`, `lab: { f(); }`, `outer: while ...`, label on a newline before a block, two labels, label + for, ternary look-alike `a ? b : c`). The last block of cases are the boundaries that stay legacy: declaration family, import/export, nested block, function body, method body — they are here to prove the shell route does not swallow them and that XML/AST stay identical, not to claim takeover.

cases.name: s4c2-fallback-decl-function
cases.source: function f() { let x = 1; if (x) f(); }
